state:
**Goal `ext-intl` — Stage 3 is on disk: the intl component is built in, and collation works end to end.** `extensions/intl/` is its own workspace with ICU4X 2.3 (`icu_experimental` pinned `=0.6.0`), built for `wasm32-wasip2` by `crates/nvs-ext/build.rs` and embedded as `nvs_ext::builtin::INTL` with its digest folded into `env_hash`. Its manifest class `Novis\Intl\Icu` declares all thirteen § 9 exports and the enums of ADR 0277 § 1, plus `NumberStyle`, `PluralKind` and `PluralCategory`, which only the WIT has. `collateOrder` and `sortKeys` are implemented (`extensions/intl/src/collation.rs`'s module doc); the other eleven return `runtime`. `Novis\Intl\Collator` is the first Novis-half class. `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs` and the three Stage 3 cases under `tests/conformance/novis/intl-*` pass.

Settled this session, against ADR 0277's *not checked* items: `icu_collator` 2.3 writes sort keys itself (`write_sort_key_to`), so § 3's fallback is not needed. `collate-order` returns, for each sorted place, the index of the input string, and the WIT doc now says so. Still open: which locale set `compiled_data` bakes in (§ 10) and which `Core\Time` accessors give a `DateTime`'s offset (§ 6). The wasm is about 1.4 MB with collation alone, because LTO drops the data no export uses yet.

Every options parameter in 0277 § 1 is written `= {}`, which does not compile; the Novis half writes `?T $options = null` (playbook, *Writing Novis itself*).

items.text: **Numbers** — `rule:core-classes/intl-batch-shape`, ADR 0277 § 4: `format-numbers` (`wit/intl.wit:198`) over `icu_decimal` and `icu_experimental`'s percent, currency and compact formatters, replacing the stub at `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:104`. A number crosses as its decimal text. Check first which formatters `icu_experimental` 0.6.0 has, and write a missing display case from the locale's data rather than dropping it. Then `Novis\Intl\NumberFormat`'s four members, which write each number as its decimal text and throw `RuntimeError` on a float that is not finite.

**Plural rules** — ADR 0277 § 4 and § 5: `plural-categories` (`wit/intl.wit:200`) over `icu_plurals`, replacing the stub at `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs:112`, and `Novis\Intl\PluralRules::cardinal` and `::ordinal`, which map each case by name to `Core\Cldr\PluralCategory`. The Stage 4 test holds them in agreement with `Core\Cldr` over its whole roster, `RULES` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/cldr.rs:2315`.

**The Stage 4 cases** — `tests/conformance/novis/intl-numbers-format-by-locale.nvst`, and the `nvs-ext` tests the Stage 4 check in `data/goals/ext-intl.json` names, added to `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs:1`.

backlog: Stage 5, dates, relative time and lists: the open § 6 question is which `Core\Time` accessors give the offset (`rule:core-classes/intl-host-converts-time`).
Stage 7: the measured size, and the locale set `compiled_data` bakes in, go in `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs`'s module doc (ADR 0277 § 10).
`Collator`'s `about.md` should say that a sort key is valid only for the version of Novis that made it (ADR 0277 § 3). It is not in the class comment, because that comment has a two-line limit.
